required_changes.how_or_why_not: Added `if home_last.has(oid) and home_deferred.has(alt.unit_id): continue` in the OBJ-ASSIGN-1 alt loop. hl_ok lambda (_capture_arrival(c).phases == 1, not too_late, not race_hopeless) filters the spare loop and pull-back; the old second spare loop (any deferred unit) is replaced by: pull-back, then undo the first deferred unit's deferral (base capture). home_deferred_fwd stores hl_fwd; a first loop undoes every deferral whose pass-2 assignment is not a capture or is worth less VP than home. The 'stays open' branch is gone.
